Getting started

  1. Download the full ZIP and extract it into a new folder.
  2. Open Assignment VS2010.sln in Visual Studio 2010.
  3. Set VehicleFinance or Policies as the startup project, then press F5.

For Question 3, open its index.html in a modern browser. Question 2 needs a 32-bit Jet or Access database provider.
